definition.source_family: One regulator/source system with a materially distinct evidence meaning; multiple files from that system remain datasets, not extra organizations.
definition.organization: One publishing regulator or public organization.
definition.dataset: One named source extract, feed, catalog, or registry.

sources.dataset: FMCSA mover identity and authority records
sources.establishes: identity, identifiers, role, recorded authority and HQ
sources.limitations: Authority is not endorsement; HQ is not service territory.

sources.dataset: institution, branch, MLO and credential records
sources.limitations: Institution, branch, person and credential are different grains.
HMDA is not lender quality; geography is property geography.

sources.establishes: a complaint was submitted and published
sources.limitations: Complaint is not violation or finding.
Credential is not endorsement; unresolved orders are not attached.
Source observation clock absent; appointment is not quality or employment.

sources.dataset: active company, MIR, examination and market catalogs
sources.grain: legal insurer, market observation, or catalog listing
sources.limitations: Examination is not enforcement; catalogs without exact joins remain unattached.

sources.dataset: Care Compare provider and evidence files
sources.grain: provider-class record or source-native evidence observation
sources.establishes: provider identity, inspections, ownership, staffing and CMS measures
sources.limitations: Nursing Home, Home Health, and Hospice stay separate; facility location is not service area.

sources.publisher: State and local contractor licensing regulators
sources.dataset: 18 connected license source systems; 10 currently live
sources.limitations: Credential is not contractor entity, endorsement, or service territory.

sources.publisher: Florida Department of Business and Professional Regulation
sources.dataset: contractor credentials, discipline, unlicensed activity and recovery fund
sources.limitations: Discipline, unlicensed activity, recovery-fund and credential rows are different evidence subtypes.

sources.publisher: U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission / IARD
sources.dataset: RIA and ERA compilations and Form ADV
sources.grain: firm, filing or Form ADV attribute
sources.establishes: firm identity, registration/reporting class and filer-reported attributes
sources.coverage_dates: current compilation plus connected filing history
sources.limitations: ERA is not RIA; RAUM is not performance; registration is not endorsement.
